ANSWER:
The query engine lives in the `src/query/` module — primarily `src/query/engine.rs`, the "deterministic textual query engine" (module doc, lines 1-14). It is a `QueryEngine<'a>` struct (line 221) wrapping a `GraphIndex` plus a normalized term → node `term_index` built in `QueryEngine::new` (lines 228-242). Supporting files: `normalize.rs` (term splitting) and `projection.rs` (canonical output), re-exported from `src/query/mod.rs:8-9`.

The engine's entry point is `QueryEngine::run(&self, plan: &QueryPlan) -> QueryResult` at `src/query/engine.rs:255`. It performs: seed lookup + deterministic integer scoring (`seed`/`score`, lines 358-462), `total` computation before truncation, max-results cap, [REDACTED-KEYNAME]-budget presentation truncation, bounded `paths` traversal (`run_paths`, line 319) and one-hop expansion (`expand`, line 469). Plans are built via `QueryPlan::parse` (line 119) and `QueryPlan::validate` (line 144).

External entry points into it:
- CLI: `dispatch` maps `"query"` → `command_query` (`src/cli.rs:71`, `src/cli.rs:2571`); it loads a `GraphIndex`, constructs the engine (`cli.rs:2588`), parses/validates the plan (`cli.rs:2601-2612`) and calls `engine.run(&plan)` at `cli.rs:2625` — or the System One wrapper `so.run(&engine, &plan, ...)` at `cli.rs:2622`, which still ends in `engine.run` (`src/system_one/service.rs:161`).
- RepositoryView mode (`--root`/`--project`/`--json` instead of `--graph`): `command_query` delegates to `run_view_query` (`src/view/service.rs:75`), which ensures the index, builds the engine (`service.rs:89`) and calls `engine.run(&plan)` at `service.rs:129`.
- Recipes reuse it via `engine.run(&plan)` at `src/recipe/exec.rs:155`.
